cohort: 1277 mother-infant pairs from a hospital-based birth cohort in Japan, recruited during pregnancy between May 2010 and November 2013.
finding: Cesarean section delivery was not associated with an increased risk of overweight or low weight status in childhood among the Japanese population studied.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was not associated with body mass index z-score at age 1, 3, or 6 years in this Japanese population.
